summary: Resolved Run 137 Blocking Finding Q1-RA-007 by turning immutable/predecessor validation into an explicit revise-Run admission boundary before mutable generation classification. Pending revise-* now validates only sourceReviewRun/sourceReviewVerdict against an exact-bound admitted matching-stage changes-requested review and does not require terminal-only reviewVerdictRef. Completed revise-* continues through validateSourceReviewTuple and is admitted only when the complete immutable tuple passes. Artifact and verification generation classifiers now receive integrityAdmittedReviseRunIds and exclude invalid pending/completed revise Runs, so invalid successors cannot suppress predecessor artifact/verification replacement conflicts. Added focused regression coverage for valid pending revision-window, invalid pending predecessor lineage, and invalid completed missing reviewVerdictRef. Delivery Full Test was not run.

resolvedFindings.evidence: readFormalFactSnapshot now consumes ImmutableValidationResult { conflicts, integrityAdmittedReviseRunIds } before either generation-aware validator. Pending revise-* uses context-only predecessor validation; completed revise-* requires the existing full validateSourceReviewTuple; invalid revise Runs are filtered out of completed artifact generation candidates and successor sets. Focused regression file covers all three Run-137 acceptance directions.
